ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as CB. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. Elluminate online synchronous class sessions will be held on Tuesdays & Thursdays from 6 to 7:30 pm.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
